name: govt-jobs-portal
description: Indian government & PSU jobs without written exam — collect, process, publish

scripts.pipeline: npm run process && npm run qa:schema
scripts.pipeline:daily: npm run collect:daily && npm run process && npm run qa:schema && npm run alert:email && npm run snapshot:prev
scripts.postinstall: echo Optional: npx playwright install chromium
scripts.setup: npm install && npm --prefix client install && npm --prefix server install && npx playwright install chromium && npm run process
scripts.static:build: node scripts/prepareStaticData.js && npm --prefix client run build
